rows.text: The Assembly's member profile of Lord Tu'ivakano states that before his appointment as a Minister in March 2005 'he was the Speaker of the Legislative Assembly', that 'He was appointed Speaker by His Majesty on 1st July 2002', and that he was Speaker 'from 2002-2004'.
rows.locator: Profile paragraphs 1-4 (heading; the March 2005 ministerial appointment; 'appointed Speaker by His Majesty on 1st July 2002'; 'from 2002-2004')
rows.uncertainty: A retrospective statement, captured on 3 February 2011; the same text was on the Assembly's ministers page by July 2005 (to_la_ministers_page_tuivakano_appointed_20020701). attested_on is the day this source gives, not a holder date: 1 July 2002 conflicts with the government statement of about 23 May 2002 that he 'embraced his appointment last week' (to_speaker_tuivakano_appointment_reported_20020523). It may be a different event, such as a commission or effective date, but the source does not say so. 'March 2005' gives no day and is not used as an end; 'from 2002-2004' is not a boundary.
